purpose: Rebaseline only the vertical-slice calendar from three days to five, preserve balance v0.2 values, adopt compact-a as the final contextual prompt design, and define implementation and human-playtest gates without inventing results.

currentRuntimeAudit.meaning: The source build still needs a date/copy implementation pass. This design task changes no runtime or localization table.

recommendedCurve.focus: survival foundation, workbench, rope and stone-axe route, food and safe-return learning
choose bag growth, camp facilities, one room module, signal investment, or a deliberate combination
finish signal stages and escape while preserving hunger, energy and daylight pressure

completionTargets.theoreticalBareMinimum: Day 2 remains mathematically possible because no costs or unlocks change; it is not the recommended full-slice path.

lockedBalanceV02.changePolicy: Change the calendar to five days first. Do not change a cost, drop, node count, energy, hunger, daylight or recovery value until valid human sessions isolate one repeated bottleneck.

skilledEarlyProof.meaning: Existing Day 3 module-plus-rescue arithmetic remains an early-success proof under the frozen values; Day 4 is extra recovery or correction room, not a gate.

firstTimeDay4.spend: workbench W2/D1; rope research D1; rope W1/D1; eat F1
axe research S1/D1; axe W1/S1; campfire W2/S1
bag W2/D1; one room W2/D1; eat F1

naturalLedgers.firstTimeDay5Variant: Follow the Day 4 ledger but gather only W3 on Day 4 and build stage 1 from W4/D2, then gather D2 on Day 5 and build stage 2 from W2/D2. Day 4 settlement is non-terminal; Day 5 stage 2 rescues immediately.
failureProofs: The frozen over-search swim benchmark can still exhaust Energy on Day 2 before the calendar extension matters.
Ending Day 3 or Day 4 with signal below stage 2 advances to the next day and never produces Deadline.
Ending Day 5 with signal below stage 2 produces Deadline exactly once.
A player who spends on optional growth without collecting food can enter later days with repeated H0 energy penalties; this is observed before any value change.

contextPromptAdoption.occlusionAcceptance: Never overlap TopHUD, BottomHelp, Mr. Kim, the active facility, a 48px walk corridor, module connector, or the narration card; use nine-slice width growth without world-space placement.

targetDistribution: At least 5 of 6 reach RESCUED, EXHAUSTED or DEADLINE within 20 minutes.
Rescue occurs in 3 or 4 of 6 valid first-user sessions.
At least two rescued first-user sessions finish on Day 4 or Day 5; Day 3 rescue is allowed but not required.
No session receives Deadline on Day 3 or Day 4.
At least one valid session ends without rescue, while no specific failure type is forced.

balanceChangeThreshold.ownerSession: Never changes a cost, drop, node, survival or recovery value.
balanceChangeThreshold.minimum: Complete the six-session ko3/en3 cohort, pass discovery and comprehension, and observe the same RESOURCE cause in at least two valid sessions.

implementationAcceptance: Change only the final calendar and deadline copy for the five-day rebaseline; preserve every locked balance value byte-for-byte or prove an unrelated pre-existing difference.
End Day 3 and End Day 4 advance to the next day with no Deadline; End Day 5 with signal below stage 2 enters Deadline exactly once.
Completing signal stage 2 on any day enters Rescued immediately and prevents later settlement or deadline mutation.
HUD uses DAY current/5 and ko/en deadline meaning says five days; qps-long remains QA-only.
screen.camp uses compact-a with separate runtime glyph and TMP, locale width profiles, a single line, and no world or route occlusion.
Connection-slot affordance candidates remain unselected review-only and are not packaged or runtime-connected by this decision.
qaAcceptance: A deterministic new-game run proves Day 1 through Day 5 transitions, no Day 3/4 deadline, exact Day 5 deadline, and immediate rescue priority.

A locked-value snapshot compares all start values, node counts and yields, costs, bag rules, movement, gathering, hunger and recovery values before and after the calendar change with zero unauthorized differences.
Natural no-grant/no-warp paths cover skilled Day 3 or 4 rescue, first-player-target Day 4 or 5 rescue, Day 2 over-search exhaustion, and Day 5 deadline.
At 1280x800 ko/en/qps-long, compact-a preserves one line, correct glyph/TMP separation, no clipping, and zero overlap with the protected HUD and world regions.
Historical three-day QA evidence remains immutable and is not reported as five-day PASS.
